The 528-point carry-free product followed by 16–40 deletions produced no gain, refuting the idea that slight truncation preserves enough multiplicative advantage. The persistent 1.094607 plateau across broad local searches suggests the 66-point basin is locally exhausted. Meanwhile, no attempt has globally enumerated small normalized sets; stochastic searches may miss rare isolated MSTD configurations, especially since optimizing \(C\) differs from maximizing \(|A+A|-|A-A|\). A bounded exhaustive search is now more informative than another refinement of the incumbent.
